title: This Fish Lays 300 Million Eggs at Once. More Than Any Vertebrate

scenes.text: This fish has more babies than any animal with a backbone.
It's the ocean sunfish, and one female can produce up to 300 million eggs at once.
It's also the heaviest bony fish known, up to 2,300 kilograms. That's over five thousand pounds.
Yet its babies hatch looking like tiny spiny pufferfish.
So this giant plays a numbers game.
Three hundred million eggs at once. Now you know why the ocean has sunfish.
